lines.en: I break the sand surface and push on.
My body rolls beneath the sand.
I bore forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，沙子下陷。
lines.en: The sand sinks where I pass.
I come along the sound of running.
I pass beneath the dune.

lines.zh: 我的背在沙上划出一道路。
lines.en: My back carves a ridge in the sand.
I turn slowly, toward you.

lines.zh: 我一边前进，沙子一边塌。
lines.en: As I advance, the sand collapses.

lines.zh: 我在这片沙漠里走了很久。
lines.en: I have travelled this desert a long while.
I arch a stretch of my body up.
I go along the sand you pressed down.

lines.zh: 我的头在沙面上冒出来。
lines.en: My head breaks the surface.
I sink, then surge forward.
I push the sand to either side.
I follow that shaking all the way.
I lie buried with only my back showing.
I heave slowly under the sand.
I listen for footsteps above.
Sand flows over my body.

lines.zh: 我把头探出沙面又埋回去。
lines.en: I push my head up and bury it again.

lines.zh: 我在等沙漠里跑起来的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something to run in this desert.
Under the desert, I wait for footsteps.
I hold still beneath the sand.
My surface is polished by sand.
I sweep my tail once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等得很有耐心。
lines.en: I wait here with great patience.

lines.zh: 我把头缩回沙里，只留一点。
lines.en: I pull my head under, leaving a little out.
You are running; I heard it.
You jump in a very regular rhythm.
I raise my head toward you.
There is not much alive in this desert.
You may try to run further.
Leave the desert and I will not follow.

lines.zh: 你的脚在沙上响得太厉害。
lines.en: Your feet rattle the sand too loudly.
I look up at you from under the sand.
Your shadow falls on my head.

lines.zh: 我这片沙下全是我的路。
lines.en: All these sands are my roads.
I twist and burrow back into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的背拱了一下，又落下。
lines.en: My back arches and drops.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很低的震响。
lines.en: I let out a low rumble.
That broke a couple of my segments.
I sink and recover.
Sand pours off me.
I swing my tail and pull back.
I head for deeper sand.

lines.zh: 这一击打在我分节的壳上。
lines.en: That blow struck my segmented shell.
My movement has slowed.
When you run, I like it more.
That tremble is meant for me.

lines.zh: 你跳两下，我就知道在哪。
lines.en: Two jumps and I know where you are.
Do you carry explosives?
I know that thumper.
Your prints in the sand are deep.
The more frantic you are, the clearer the shaking.
Standing on sand, you stand out.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下来，我就靠近。
lines.en: Set it down and I come close.
The sand here is soft; easy going.
I hit you and sand flies up.

lines.zh: 你被我从下面顶了一下。
lines.en: I butt you from below.
We brush past each other in the sand.
My impact collapses a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 你踩在我背上，滑了下去。
lines.en: You step on my back and slide off.
Your hit knocks me off course.
At the impact, sand rises like a wave.
I pull back and leave a pit.
That knocked you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我们分开，沙还在往下塌。
lines.en: We part and the sand keeps sliding.
I patrol alone beneath the sand.
This desert holds only one of me.
I am interested only in vibration.

lines.zh: 在沙上问这个，不太明智。
lines.en: Asking that on sand is unwise.
I sink slowly away.
That is not my concern.
I swing my tail as a reply.
It is quiet under the sand; I like it.
What I wait for is not this.
Go; I will not follow.
I swallow the thing into the sand.
I bite it and drag it under.
Once in the sand, it is mine.

lines.zh: 我张嘴一合，它就没影了。
lines.en: My jaws close once, and it is gone.
Too small even for my teeth.
I bury it in the sand bed.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的牙缝漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks out between my teeth.
I take what falls on the sand.
I push it up to the surface.
The sand covers everything.
I have locked onto that running.
You are in my sand.
I head for the shaking.
This target is on the sand.

lines.zh: 我扬起头，对着你的方向。
lines.en: I rear up my head, aimed your way.

lines.zh: 我顺着震动的方向去了。
lines.en: I go along the direction of the shaking.
Your position is beneath my sand.
All this sand is me.
I need not see you.
Those two jumps were enough.
I begin to speed up.
You are still far from the desert's edge.
I have that footfall memorised.
I arch my back toward you.
Under the sand, I keep with you.
You run, and my sand moves with you.
I gain on you stretch by stretch.
Your step halts, and the sand goes still.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的路线拱过去。
lines.en: I heave along your route.
Do you hear the sand hissing?
The more you run, the deeper you go.

lines.zh: 我不用抬头也知道你在。
lines.en: I need not surface to know you are there.
You are on the dune; I am beneath.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕着你的路线。
lines.en: I slowly coil around your path.
At this distance, almost there.
Your breathing is quickening.

lines.zh: 我一直在等你跑到没力气。
lines.en: I wait for you to run out of strength.
The desert does not favour you.
I burst up from the sand and strike.
My teeth close on your leg.

lines.zh: 我从沙里竖起半截身子。
lines.en: Half of me rises from the sand.
I bite at your waist.

lines.zh: 沙子被我的动作甩起来。
lines.en: My movement flings the sand up.

lines.zh: 你被我从下面顶到半空。
lines.en: I launch you from below.
That blow carried the weight of sand.
I bite once and sink away.
You pull back, and the pit remains.
That leaves you unsteady.
The sand surface bulges hugely.

lines.zh: 我先从地下发出一声闷响。
lines.en: I send up a dull rumble from underground.
The sand begins to drain down.
I break out of the dune's flank.

lines.zh: 整片沙丘都塌下去一块。
lines.en: A whole dune collapses inward.

lines.zh: 我拱起一段背，又沉下去。
lines.en: I arch my back up and sink again.
The ground here starts to tremble.
I rear up, taller than the dune.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹起，我就在里面。
lines.en: The wind lifts the sand, and I am within it.

lines.zh: 我从很深的地方上来了。
lines.en: I have come up from very deep.

lines.zh: 火在沙上烧，我往深处钻。
lines.en: Fire burns on the sand and I burrow deeper.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上翻下去，砸出坑。
lines.en: I tumble off the dune and smash a pit.
Water floods in and my movement goes wild.

lines.zh: 炸开的坑里，我张嘴吸气。
lines.en: In the blasted crater I open my maw and breathe.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我背上，没进多深。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back, not deep.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的震动弱了。
lines.en: Magic hits and my tremor weakens.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没有猎物，我饿了。
lines.en: No prey in this desert, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙面上，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and I convulse.
The void pulls and the sand cannot hold me.
